info.name: Digital Assistant Service Instance Odapackage API
List packages that have been imported into the given instance.

params.name: odaInstanceId
params.description: Unique Digital Assistant instance identifier.

params.name: name
params.description:
List only the information for the package with this name. Package names are unique to a publisher and may not change.

Example: `My Package`

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.

params.name: page
params.description:
The page at which to start retrieving results.

You get this value from the `opc-next-page` header in a previous list request.
To retireve the first page, omit this query parameter.

Example: `MToxMA==`

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: Sort the results in this order, use either `ASC` (ascending) or `DESC` (descending).

params.name: sortBy
params.description:
Sort on this field. You can specify one sort order only. The default sort field is `TIMECREATED`.

The default sort order for `TIMECREATED` is descending, and the default sort order for `DISPLAYNAME` is ascending.

items.docs: Returns a list of summaries for imported packages in the instance.

info.name: Import Package into Digital Assistant Instance

params.name: odaInstanceId
params.description: Unique Digital Assistant instance identifier.

items.docs:
Starts an asynchronous job to import a package into a Digital Assistant instance.

To monitor the status of the job, take the `opc-work-request-id` response
header value and use it to call `GET /workRequests/{workRequestId}`.

items.docs:
Starts an asynchronous job to update a package within a Digital Assistant instance.

To monitor the status of the job, take the `opc-work-request-id` response
header value and use it to call `GET /workRequests/{workRequestId}`.

To monitor the status of the job, take the `opc-work-request-id` response
